scphase.source: release imports plus README installation instruction

runtime_path_resolution.scope: All relative input, upstream-checkout, checkpoint, log and result paths in this protocol resolve under the runtime workspace, not under the Git repository.
runtime_path_resolution.default: the repository parent directory, outside the standalone Git worktree

official_age_rule.candidate_universe_rule: the frozen project input view is encoded by UCE first; released seed-0 replace-true sampling then draws 1024 cells per donor
official_age_rule.project_input_views: CIMA natural_1024 seed 20260711, Immunobiology official_1500 seed 20260711, and OneK1K deterministic up-to-1500 seed 20260711
official_age_rule.effective_uce_filter_order: first gene min_cells=10 -> first cell min_genes=25 -> case-insensitive PE gene intersection; the released second filter call mutates discarded ad, not returned adata, and is not applied as an intended bug fix

PULSAR.external_fit: same Ridge alpha on all 417 CIMA donors, then freeze

cima_continuous_task_adapter.cima_alignment: preserve released gene_order order and omit source-absent genes exactly as released align_gene_space
cima_continuous_task_adapter.external_alignment: reuse the exact frozen CIMA input order and zero-fill target-source-absent columns solely to preserve the trained input dimension
cima_continuous_task_adapter.cell_filter: filter source-space total_counts == 0 as in the released multilabel query; preserve cells that become all-zero only after gene alignment

PaSCient.continuous_scaler: released per-cell pandas ddof=1 rule fit on CIMA training-fold cells only

loss_shape_adaptation.correction: identical [N,D] prediction/target shapes within each view; view means unchanged

PaSCient.checkpoint_selection: fixed released epoch-4 last.ckpt for CIMA OOF and external inference
PaSCient.external_fit: full-CIMA checkpoint for external prediction; outer-fold models for CIMA OOF evaluation
PaSCient.role: official-code continuous-age adaptation; no author-released age experiment configuration exists

official_age_preprocessing.input_state: not documented by release; all_pbmcs_rna.h5ad is read and used directly
official_age_preprocessing.hvg: scanpy.pp.highly_variable_genes, n_top_genes=5000, flavor=cell_ranger, min_mean=0.0125, max_mean=3, min_disp=0.5, CIMA batch_key=RNA_experiment
official_age_preprocessing.executed_input_view: fixed 1500 cells per donor: 625500 CIMA cells and 351000 Immunobiology cells
official_age_preprocessing.executed_hvg_fallback: global CIMA cell_ranger after all-zero gene removal when batch-aware Scanpy quantiles failed
official_age_preprocessing.external_missing_hvg_rule: zero-fill the 1230 source-absent frozen CIMA HVGs before applying frozen CIMA scaling

internal_tracks.official_native: retain real donor-constant CIMA RNA_experiment groups; released runner selects LeaveOneGroupOut (50 groups in the frozen cohort)
internal_tracks.common_OOF: set one synthetic group only in the explicit donor-order adapter; released runner then selects shuffled KFold(5, seed=3407)

scPhase.external_transform: reuse the ordered CIMA HVGs and CIMA-fitted mean/std, then apply the released scale transform

IDEAL-Age.formal_variant: complete pseudo-bulk AutoGluon FASTAI/NN_TORCH plus DeepSets-Attention ensemble

UCE.patient_level_rule: apply one CIMA-fitted unregularized linear age readout to each official UCE cell embedding, then take the arithmetic mean of cell predictions within donor
UCE.external_preprocessing: CIMA gene mask and UCE-supported gene identifiers
